about: Entries for the Automation Monitor dashboard (https://monitor.ravitejaknts.com). One entry per scheduled job, workflow or service. key: <machine>/<job> (machines: homelab, bloxodes-vps, stack127-vps, macbook-pro, macbook-air; job = cron run-job.sh name, systemd unit without .timer/.service, launchd label or T3 schedule title), github/<owner>/<repo>/<workflow file>, supabase/<function or pg_cron job>, or northflank/<job>. name: short plain name. group: the section it is listed under. about: one sentence on what it does, written for the owner. impact (optional): what breaks if it stops. records (optional): stats_job_runs.job_name values it writes. ignore_records: job names that are sub-steps of other jobs.

automations.name: New game stats
automations.about: Refreshes player counts and visits for recently added Roblox games, then queues their pages for a cache refresh.
automations.impact: New games show old or missing numbers.

automations.name: Find popular new games
automations.about: Looks for trending Roblox games that Bloxodes does not track yet and adds them to the stats list.
automations.impact: Newly popular games are missed.

automations.name: Hot game stats
automations.about: Refreshes the most-played Roblox games every hour on Northflank, so the busiest stats pages stay current.
automations.impact: Top games show stale player counts.

automations.name: Warm game stats
automations.about: Refreshes mid-popularity games every 6 hours.
automations.impact: Mid-popularity games fall behind.

automations.name: Cold game stats and search index
automations.about: Refreshes less-played games, then rebuilds the current stats index used by listings and search.
automations.impact: Quiet games and game listings go stale.

automations.name: Hourly game rankings
automations.about: Ranks games by how many people are playing right now, for the top-games lists.
automations.impact: Top-games rankings stop moving.

automations.name: Game stats health check
automations.about: Checks that game stats are fresh and complete. Fails when too many games are overdue for a refresh.
automations.impact: Stats problems go unnoticed.

automations.name: Daily game stats summary
automations.about: Turns yesterday's hourly numbers into one daily row per game, deletes hourly rows older than 90 days, then audits the result.
automations.impact: Daily charts miss days and the database keeps growing.

automations.name: Roblox-wide totals
automations.about: Recalculates platform totals such as all players online across Roblox.
automations.impact: Roblox-wide totals go stale.

automations.name: Job-run history cleanup
automations.about: Closes job-run records that were left open by crashed or killed worker runs.

automations.name: Stats worker rebuild
automations.about: Rebuilds the stats worker container from the approved code version, so VPS jobs run the latest reviewed code.
automations.impact: VPS jobs keep running old code.

automations.name: Restart recovery
automations.about: After the VPS reboots, waits for Docker and restarts containers that failed to start, such as Kong after an IP clash.
automations.impact: The site can stay down after a reboot.

automations.name: Item refresh priorities
automations.about: Sorts Roblox catalog items into hot, warm and cold, which decides how often each one is refreshed.

automations.name: New item stats
automations.about: Fetches prices and sales for newly found catalog items.

automations.name: Hot item stats
automations.about: Refreshes prices and sales for the most-viewed catalog items most hours of the day.
automations.impact: Popular item pages show old prices.

automations.name: Warm item stats
automations.about: Refreshes mid-popularity catalog items four times a day.

automations.name: Cold item stats
automations.about: Refreshes rarely viewed catalog items once a day.

automations.name: Item resale prices
automations.about: Collects resale price history for limited items.

automations.name: Item search index
automations.about: Rebuilds the current item index that powers catalog listings, filters and search.

automations.name: Daily item stats summary
automations.about: Turns yesterday's item numbers into one daily row per item for the charts.

automations.name: Item stats health check
automations.about: Checks that item stats are fresh. Fails when too many items are past their refresh deadline.

automations.name: Find new catalog items
automations.about: Searches the Roblox catalog for new items and queues them for details and stats.

automations.name: Catalog item details
automations.about: Fills in names, images, creators and prices for catalog items that are missing details.

automations.name: Find free items
automations.about: Imports items that might be free so the next job can check them.

automations.name: Check free items
automations.about: Confirms which items are still free and updates the free items page.
automations.impact: The free items page lists items that now cost Robux.

automations.name: Promo code rewards
automations.about: Checks Roblox promo code rewards once a week and retires rewards that disappeared.

automations.name: Music ID library
automations.about: Collects popular Roblox song IDs for the music ID pages.

automations.name: Decal ID library
automations.about: Collects popular Roblox decal IDs for the decal ID pages.

automations.name: Roblox events
automations.about: Collects upcoming Roblox virtual events and their details for the events pages. Meant to be switched off; see known issues in the Bloxodes docs.

automations.name: Codes refresh
automations.about: Re-checks every codes page for new and expired codes four times a day.
automations.impact: Codes pages show expired codes or miss new ones.

automations.name: Find new codes pages
automations.about: Looks for games that got a codes page on Beebom and adds them to the queue.

automations.name: Write draft codes pages
automations.about: Writes and publishes new codes pages from the queue, ten times a day.
automations.impact: No new codes pages. Note: a green run can still write nothing if the AI credits are out.

automations.name: Google indexing (VPS)
automations.about: Sends updated pages to the Google Indexing API. Switched off.

automations.name: Google indexing
automations.about: Sends updated pages to the Google Indexing API on request. Switched off.

automations.name: Early NYT puzzles
automations.about: Fetches the first NYT puzzle answers of the day (Wordle, Connections and others).

automations.name: Beebom puzzle answers
automations.about: Fetches puzzle answers from Beebom, three tries each morning.

automations.name: Late NYT and LinkedIn puzzles
automations.about: Fetches the NYT and LinkedIn puzzles that publish later in the day.

automations.name: All puzzles sweep
automations.about: Fetches every puzzle again and requires today's answers to be present.

automations.name: Puzzle health check
automations.about: Checks that every puzzle page has today's answers.
automations.impact: A missing puzzle answer goes unnoticed.

automations.name: Find article topics
automations.about: Finds new article ideas, then lets an AI pick the best ones. When it succeeds it starts the article writer.
automations.impact: No new articles are planned.

automations.name: Write articles
automations.about: Writes up to 6 articles from the picked topics and publishes them automatically. Starts after topic discovery succeeds.

automations.name: Publish approved articles
automations.about: Every 15 minutes, publishes articles that are approved and verified. Then runs the article health check.

automations.name: Article health check
automations.about: Reports blocked articles and checks the article queue and schedules. Runs after each publish pass.
automations.impact: Stuck articles go unnoticed.

automations.name: Nightly other-games pages
automations.about: A T3 agent takes the next Ready game from the Other Games queue in Notion, builds its pages and publishes them.

automations.name: Nightly Roblox wiki
automations.about: A T3 agent takes the top uncovered Roblox game from the Roblox Wiki queue, builds its collections and hub, and publishes them.

automations.name: Page cache refresh
automations.about: Every minute, refreshes website pages whose data changed, so visitors see new numbers quickly.
automations.impact: Pages keep showing old data.

automations.name: Page cache warming
automations.about: Every minute, loads refreshed pages once so the first visitor gets a fast page.

automations.name: Deploy the website
automations.about: Builds the website and deploys it to the VPS when code reaches production.
automations.impact: Merged changes do not go live.

automations.name: Pull request checks
automations.about: Runs tests, type checks and builds on every pull request.

automations.name: AI code review
automations.about: Asks Codex to review selected pull requests. Fails while the OpenAI key is out of quota. It does not block merging.

automations.name: Database changes release
automations.about: Applies database migrations. Called by the deploy and publish workflows.

automations.name: Content checks
automations.about: Checks new content in managed development before it is published.

automations.name: Publish content
automations.about: Copies selected content from managed development to production.

automations.name: Website audit
automations.about: Runs a full website health and SEO audit on request.

automations.name: Package article runtime
automations.about: Packages the code the homelab article automation runs. Started by hand when the runtime needs an update.

automations.name: Stats health alert
automations.about: Checks site and stats health and sends a Telegram alert when the state changes. Set to every 5 minutes, but GitHub runs it much less often.
automations.impact: No Telegram alert when stats break.

automations.name: RobloxGo place crawl
automations.about: Collects Roblox place IDs from RobloxGo into a staging database on Northflank, to find games Bloxodes does not track yet.
